Yizhi Zhao

M.Sc. student at EPFL · Project student at VITA Lab

I have expertise in machine learning, generative modeling, and data science. My recent work focuses on learning-based approaches for autonomous driving, including end-to-end planning, world models, and reinforcement learning. I'm broadly interested in how learning-based methods can enable intelligent systems to better perceive, reason, and act in complex real-world environments.

I'm a master's student at EPFL, and I completed my undergraduate studies at Southeast University. I'm particularly interested in applying machine learning to challenging real-world problems, and I'm open to opportunities across machine learning, autonomous driving, robotics, and data science.
